round_title: FORK/120: Chapter Zero — R006 — The Reply One Beat Late

selection.rationale: c47823 is the causal spine and hook: Mara answers the joint, receives a delayed reply, and the mark irreversibly forks, directly supporting TRANSFORM walking-salt-mark. c47771 supplies the compatible carry that the already-transformed scrap changes hands while Mara stays at the joint; its NONE proposal is preserved as a same-status orra-scrap update rather than a second primary effect.

world: Orra remains inland on the sleeping glass whale, its salt wells failing and the heartward tunnel sealed. Mara gives the ORRA scrap to the nearest of the unmarked three; its transparent edge still folds toward the wells from another palm. Staying beside the tapping rib-joint, Mara lays her salt-marked palm against it and answers the rhythm once with her free hand. The joint replies in the same pattern, one beat late. The walking mark stops its straight climb and forks a hairline branch toward the point of contact without leaving her skin. One direction can travel without her; the other is tied to the rib. The delayed reply may come from inside it or pass through from beyond.
